intro.@es: El participio activo de pasado caracteriza al agente por una acción anterior: прочитавший, приехавшая, построившие.
intro.@en: The active participle of the past characterizes the agent by an earlier action: прочитавший, приехавшая, построившие.

texto.@en: Concords with the noun in gender and number, and retains supplements of the verb from which it comes.
